name: Staff clerk lever (samples the NEEDS count as the clerk's metric; at level act and NEEDS at or above target, runs the NEEDS sweep once per window)

knobs.note: BH-9420 test seam: epoch seconds used as the clock, only with HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 and only all-digit values. NOT settable from the control plane. The level, target, lever window and dry mode are settings rows (staff.clerk.level, staff.clerk.target, staff.clerk.lever_every_hours, console.needs.sweep_dry_run), not lane knobs.
BH-9420 test seam: 1 = load clerk_action_verdict and return before the run. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/staff/clerk-lever.sh honors CLERK_NOW only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
